objective: Screen two cross-asset defensive-trend sleeves (D1 Carlson Defense First TAA, D2 12-month-vs-SHY absolute momentum with inverse-63-session-vol sizing) via scripts/screen_batch.py, each judged by K2 (combination Sharpe edge over vol-matched S3 >=0.05 in anchor and stress) or K1 (standalone offset-median Sharpe >=80% of S3's own median in both windows, positive 20bp CAGR), with all 21 monthly rebalance-day offsets swept and judged by the median.

parameters.source: run_h20260923_12_s3_defense_first.defense_weights, generalized to an arbitrary asof date (calendar_return helper) so offsets != 0 can be evaluated without look-ahead; rank weights, hurdle and fallback unedited from the published rule
queue task T-20260928-02 round-number thresholds (12-month absolute momentum vs SHY, 63-session inverse vol sizing), not tuned; mechanism grounded in Moskowitz-Ooi-Pedersen 2012 time-series momentum

data_v1_screen_lane_sip_daily_panel.hygiene: drop bars with zero volume and zero trade_count (screen_lane.load_batch_panel via base.load_panel)
data_v1_screen_lane_sip_daily_panel.source: alpaca SIP daily archive, fully adjusted closes
data_v1_screen_lane_sip_daily_panel.panel_start: 2015-01-02 (screen_lane.PANEL_START); first local daily bar for TLT/GLD/DBC/UUP/SHY confirmed 2016-01-04

feature_v1_defense_first_generalized_sig.definition: For a signal date asof, calendar_return(close, sym, asof, months) = close.at[asof, sym] / close.at[nearest trading day <= asof - months calendar months, sym] - 1, using close.loc[:asof] only. D1's score per symbol is the mean of this over months in [1,3,6,12]; rank TLT/GLD/DBC/UUP by score, weight 0.40/0.30/0.20/0.10 by rank, any symbol whose score < BIL's score has its tier weight redirected to SPY. At offset 0, asof is the true month-end and this reproduces H-20260923-12's DF01 reading exactly; at offset>0, asof is a later trading day in the same rebalance cycle.

feature_v1_absolute_momentum_inverse_vol.definition: For a signal date asof: eligible = {sym in TLT,GLD,DBC,UUP : calendar_return(close, sym, asof, 12) > calendar_return(close, SHY, asof, 12)}; if eligible is empty, 100% SHY; else weight each eligible symbol by 1/std(daily returns over the trailing 63 sessions ending at asof, ddof=1), normalized to sum 1.

label_v1_next_session_open_to_open_total.definition: weights decided at signal-date close, effective at the next session open (screen_lane.weights_frame); combination and control apply the same next-open convention

holdout_2026_contaminated: already seen for S3 and for D1's SPY-fallback sibling in H-20260923-12; reported for reference only
validation_v1_screen_lane_select_anchor_.offsets: 21 monthly rebalance-day offsets (0-20 trading sessions after month-end), judged by the median (screen_lane.judged_offset)

g3_not_applicable_reason: G3 (random-menu/random-calendar placebo) does not apply to this cross-asset trend/combination question, the same reasoning H-20260927-01 documented: there is no discretionary asset pick or gate-timing signal to randomize (D1's ranking is fully determined by published momentum scores; D2's eligibility is a deterministic threshold). The volatility-matched delevered-S3 control (via screen_lane.diversifier_edge_for_offset) is the placebo-equivalent check here -- it isolates 'same risk, no diversification' so any D1/D2 combination advantage must come from genuine cross-sleeve diversification, not from running at higher average risk.

per_candidate: K2 (primary): judged (median-offset) combination Sharpe (S3+D, inverse-63-session-vol weighted) minus vol-matched delevered-S3 control Sharpe >= 0.05 in BOTH the anchor window and the stress period (screen_lane.diversifier_edge_for_offset judged_edge, per window)

K1 (fallback if K2 fails): standalone judged (median-offset) Sharpe at 10bp >= 80% of S3's own median Sharpe in BOTH the anchor window (bar 1.19, 80% of S3's 1.49) and the stress period (bar 0.65, 80% of S3's 0.81), AND 20bp CAGR positive in both windows
adoption_rule.strong_reserve: K2 edge >= 0.10 in both windows, or K1's Sharpe not below S3's own in either window
adoption_rule.pass_requires: D1 or D2 clears K2, or clears K1
adoption_rule.multiple_comparisons: two candidates (D1, D2); report both regardless of outcome; DSR reported at n_trials=2
adoption_rule.also_reported: D1/D2 standalone judged Sharpe (select/anchor/stress/holdout2026), correlation with S3 in stress/anchor/2022, DSR at anchor
adoption_rule.fallback_if_none_pass: no cross-asset sleeve added to the live pilot on this evidence; S3 alone remains the reference
